description: This file defines an interface IStorageManager within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. The interface specifies methods for managing storage associated with applications, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage, with detailed documentation for each method.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An interface class for managing application storage, providing methods to create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage for applications.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified application ID, returning a storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage location and usage details for a given application ID, user ID, and group ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specified application ID, providing an error reason if needed.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specified application ID, also clearing device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all application data except for exempted app IDs, supporting bulk storage clearing.
